brief:
Palestinian voters demonstrated strong turnout in recent elections, according to Al Jazeera English, drawing scrutiny to how Arab citizens fare within Israel's democratic system. Xavier Abu Eid said the participation reveals the political inclusion and exclusion patterns faced by Arab populations living in Israel.

The turnout figures have sparked debate over the relationship between electoral participation and citizenship rights for Arab communities.
dek: The strong Palestinian turnout has exposed how Arab citizens are treated within Israel's democracy, says Xavier Abu Eid.
title: Palestinian voter turnout exposes Israel's treatment of Arab citizens
